scene.shiki: Full 20-year-old Kusa Jonin, has examined Inaba's numbered medical tag by normal visible methods, no chakra and no further spoken dialogue. Plate rests in front of him on clean napkin.
scene.seina: Present. She opened patient jacket seam, observed plate, notes official Kiri query would leave trace, respects Inaba denial of external disclosure, offers to examine object's composition/markings and locally search records.
scene.inaba: Awake, cold weak right hand with patchy capillary flow and neurological deficits, suspected foreign graft; pending tissue comparison. He says tag twice was used at different medical posts to get weekly medicine, later warned to hide it. Refuses official external inquiry and asks not to disclose location.
scene.plate: Gray metal ~5x3cm 2mm. Front МЕДИЦИНСКИЙ РЕЕСТР / М-4 / 031 / РЕЦИПИЕНТ / Контроль: 7 суток. Reverse Сложная тканевая трансплантация / Экстренное обращение: медицинский узел М-4. Worn lanyard hole; near edge four slanted waves vaguely Kirigakure-like but not exact official icon; six tiny edge notches four with dark hardened substance, function unknown. No patient name. No scan or authentication yet.

major_timeline: Shiki defeated Rock Lee and Dosu in tournament; Dosu unconscious with severe cervical soft-tissue injury and possible concussion, death not established.

Shiki voluntarily surrendered to Gaara before any attack. Original Gaara July question was «Когда ты убиваешь человека, ты чувствуешь, что существуешь?» Shiki replied «Я существую всегда» and then «Да», without revealing motives.
Gaara won final against Neji; Neji seriously injured in legs and unconscious when sent for med care; no confirmed long-term prognosis.
Konoha invasion by Sound and possible Sand; Hokage vs impostor Kazekage identified as Orochimaru within purple barrier at arena.

Shiki broke mass-sleep genjutsu via Kai, Shunshin and chakra scalpel incapacitated two Sound shinobi trying to seal medical passage; fatal intent stated but deaths not confirmed. Does not pursue retreating infiltrators.

Ren and medics evacuated real bleeding guard; Shiki cut chakra-thread trap with chakra scalpels. Another hidden accomplice escaped, cylinder dropped near entrance. Leaf jonin Asuma Sarutobi and Kurenai Yuhi took over security; Kakashi and Might Guy fought elsewhere.

Shiki participated in evacuating initial six injured plus one freshly rescued guard. All reached central block. He was explicitly permitted to speak for himself to Tose in one conversation only; verbatim transcript attached.
Tose checked Sound attackers' status, no confirmation of their survival/death, refused to report assumed deaths.
23 Aug 1278 Shiki promoted to Chunin by Kusagakure after Konoha recommendation.

24 Aug 1278 Post 6 mission successful: Shiki medically stabilized and saved archival witness Minagi; biological registry 37 samples, 6 repeat observations, 1 stable case. Kusa archive tampering and false pre-promotion Shiki assignment uncovered.
3 Sep 1278 Shiki privately confirmed to Seina that Kabuto requested blood/tissue sample; he voluntarily provided no sample.

19 Sep 1278 Kabuto-attributed personalized letter delivered and shown to Shiki by Seina. His original age-seven medical card matches private shorthand quote; Kabuto claims prior knowledge of Shiki's physiology. None of this proves Kabuto possessed Shiki's DNA or controlled Post 6.

September 1278–September 1283: five-year player-authorized timeskip and extraordinary skill growth, official 68 completed missions, two successful secret somatic gene assimilations Haku Hyoton (March 1281) and limited Hozuki hydration (August 1282).
21 Nov 1281 Shiki appointed Tokubetsu Jonin specializing medical reconnaissance. 15 May 1283 appointed full Jonin.
September 1283 Shiki elite S+ Body Flicker speed Shisui-level or above at straight prepared burst, not teleport; exactly 7 primary named techniques.
Medium-term Sharingan is only a research objective: not obtained or activated.

Secret genetic assimilation #1: authentic preserved sample of deceased Haku obtained covertly from Water Country archives in 1280, successful Hyoton March1281; no living Haku harmed. #2: archived deceased Hozuki tissue sample obtained and partial hydratation by Aug1282. Not publicly known.

Stable NPC roster, no duplicate filler names. Senior mentor Seina with unique voice and real medical ethics; no all-NPC knowledge leakage.
Live story must reflect mature five-year political and personal consequences, not a frozen Konoha exam era.
Exactly 12 named core techniques: original seven plus Raiton weapon channel, Suiton Water Clone, Water Prison, Water Dragon and Hyoton Thousand Ice Needles; extra unnamed field medical skills remain.
Naruto universe remains organically active through Konoha, Mist, Sand, Sound, Akatsuki and Uchiha. Offscreen events are NOT known to Shiki; only relevant witnessed/reported evidence.
